title: For n>=2 and m>=3 over a field containing a primitive m-th root q, the Taft-cyclic smash products T_(n*m^2)^(xi^t) and T_(n*m^2)^(xi^tprime) are isomorphic exactly when xi^(s*tprime-t)=q^l with gcd(s,n)=1
author: Ana-Loredana Agore
source_title: Hopf Algebras which Factorize through the Taft Algebra Tm2(q) and the Group Hopf Algebra K[Cn]
difficulty_reason: An algebra-generator substitution alone does not classify these Hopf algebras, because a general morphism can mix the Taft and cyclic factors through additional coalgebra maps. The author solves the full compatibility system and proves that all invertible morphisms reduce to a specific scaling and group-like mixing. The converse constructs and checks an explicit inverse, completing the classification over fields that need not contain every n-th root of unity.
source_version: Official SIGMA 14 (2018) article 027, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2018.027; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: The complete Theorem3.4 proof and matched-pair construction3.1/3.2 were read. Prior Theorem2.3 gives the general quadruple parameterization of smash-product Hopf morphisms. The new proof solves every relevant coalgebra and compatibility condition, forces the auxiliary Hopf map p to be trivial and the skew-primitive scaling to be nonzero, proves the cyclic exponent is invertible, and constructs the explicit inverse using Bezout exponents. The Taft primitive-element description and the full defining relations are included as context. The numerical isomorphism-type count3.5 and automorphism-group corollary3.6 are not separate claims.

statement_scope: Exactly Theorem3.4 under Section3 assumptions n>=2,m>=3 and field K containing a primitive m-th root q. U_n(K) is cyclic of order nu(n), xi is any generator, and t,tprime range from0 to nu(n)-1. The explicit nm^2-dimensional smash-product Hopf algebras are those of Corollary3.2. They are isomorphic iff l in0..m-1 and s in0..n-1 exist with gcd(s,n)=1 and xi^(s*tprime-t)=q^l. Do not assume nu(n)=n or algebraic closure. No isomorphism-type count or m=2 variant is counted.
source_boundary_note: The complete original Theorem 3.4 and full author classification proof are retained, under n>=2, m>=3 and a field containing a primitive m-th root. U_n(K), its possibly smaller order nu(n), the Taft skew-primitives and exact smash-product relations are included. The full new matched-pair construction is bundled as uncounted core. The author solves every coalgebra/compatibility condition, proves the cyclic exponent is a unit and constructs the explicit Bezout inverse. The prior general quadruple parameterization of Hopf morphisms is retained as cited standard background. Numerical isomorphism-type counts and the automorphism-group consequence are not counted.
